comment: Vercel only reads vercel.json at the PROJECT ROOT. If a project's Root Directory is this repo root rather than nfl/, then nfl/vercel.json is ignored entirely -- which means no cache headers, and a phone can sit on an old index.html indefinitely, serving old ?v= stamps and therefore old JS. This file covers that case. It is harmless when the project root really is nfl/, because then Vercel reads that one instead. Deliberately no cleanUrls here: the personal site's pages are linked as .html and rewriting them would break those links.

headers.comment: Assets carry a build stamp, so revalidating costs nothing and no device can be stranded on an old build.
The pool is private. Only that path -- the rest of the site is meant to be indexed.
